mapper.select: SELECT w.*, m.name AS memberName, c.name AS courseName, c.start_time AS courseStartTime FROM waiting_queue w LEFT JOIN member m ON w.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN course c ON w.course_id = c.id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY w.create_time DESC

SELECT w.*, c.name AS courseName, c.start_time AS courseStartTime FROM waiting_queue w LEFT JOIN course c ON w.course_id = c.id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} AND w.status = 1 AND w.notified = 0 ORDER BY w.update_time ASC
